plan.qualification: Six traced2MiB children (three source kinds,whole/1MiB),then nine parameter-validated full-size children (one sample/configuration). Stop before clean timing on any failure.
plan.comparison: Three fixed clean cohorts,9 independent native processes each. Record first copy separately and five subsequent samples/process. Reset and full guard/payload readback outside each timed copy. Staging includes its full std::memcpy. Allocations/source construction outside timing; setup clocks retained. First-copy means post-initialization,not driver cold start. Full readback may perturb later samples; source kind also bundles pointer alignment/import behavior. No model or device-memory-pressure simulation.
plan.timing: Every full timed sample>=100ms;1000-pair maximum stamp overhead<=1ms and<=1% of each sample. No retries/replaced samples. Failure preserves extracted samples and closes the experiment.
plan.selection: Compare each alternative to vector whole within each cohort. Require every cohort throughput ratio>=1.02 and geometric mean>=1.05. Select largest eligible geomean for a separate model-specific plan only. No clean speed-based early stopping.
plan.retention: Keep individual source/shape/phase samples,setup/timer/alignment,source/runtime and fault/owner outcomes. Retire successful full traces and frozen metadata after verified committed closure. Preserve6e40 fallback; overwrite only the recoverable comparison cache.

decision.scope: Component screen only; unpressured host-pointer reuse after full readback,not model speed,physical bus saturation or inference adoption.
